upcoming.title: Unveiling the Path to Open Source Success: GSoC and Beyond
upcoming.description: A webinar to help you ace Google Summer of Code and get insights from experienced contributors. Learn how to make meaningful contributions to open source projects, prepare a strong GSoC application, and build your developer portfolio.

upcoming.title: Hackémon: 36 Hour Hackathon
upcoming.description: Welcome to HACKEMON: Code, Create, Conquer! ⚡ Powered by SheBuilds. Join us for an exciting 36-hour hackathon where you'll collaborate with fellow developers to build innovative solutions. Great prizes, mentorship, and networking opportunities await!

past.title: Web and Flutter Development Workshop
past.description: Level up your skills with this beginner-friendly hands-on workshop. Participants learned the fundamentals of web development with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, followed by an introduction to cross-platform development with Flutter.

past.title: Introductory Session for Solutions Challenge 2025
past.description: Kick-off session for the GDG Solutions Challenge 2025. This information session covered the rules, timeline, and expectations for the Google Developer Solutions Challenge, along with tips from previous successful participants.

past.title: Dev December - Flutter Your Way to Android
past.description: Holiday learning with Flutter! This hands-on workshop guided participants through building their first Flutter app with a focus on Android development. Perfect for beginners looking to enter mobile development.

past.title: DevByte - A Web Development Odyssey
past.description: Web development crash course for beginners. This intensive one-day workshop covered HTML, CSS, JavaScript fundamentals, and responsive design principles. Participants created their own portfolio website by the end of the session.
